address: 12F, Cathay Building, Jin Jiang Hotel, 59 South Maoming Road, Huangpu, Shanghai, China Mainland
bio: Shanghainese are no strangers to Ningbo cuisine and they know what they like! This restaurant with bags of old Shanghai charm serves wild-caught seafood shipped daily from Ningbo then meticulously prepared to highlight its natural flavours. Portion sizes can be tailored to your party size, and the emphasis is on seasonal items, such as razor clams from Ninghai (available Mar-May). The yellow croaker roe aspic and handmade glutinous rice balls are also worth trying....
